notice: SYNTHETIC / FICTIONAL deviation records for Examplon Pharma (fictional). No real events.

records.description: Tablet press compression force reading drifted 6% above setpoint during run; operator noticed rising rejects.
records.immediate_action: Press stopped, lot quarantined, rejects segregated and weighed.
records.investigation_summary: Force sensor checked against reference: out of tolerance. Review showed the calibration interval had been extended from 3 to 6 months to save workload with no assessment.
records.root_cause: Calibration interval extended without a change assessment, so sensor drift was not caught in time.
records.product_impact: Lot sampled at 3x normal frequency; weight and hardness in specification.

capa.summary: Restored 3-month interval; added rule that interval changes need SOP-CHG-002 assessment.
capa.effectiveness_result: verified effective: no recurrence in 6 months

records.description: Blending ran 2 minutes short of the 15-minute instruction after the operator was called away by an alarm.
records.immediate_action: Blend restarted for the missing time; blend uniformity sampled.
records.investigation_summary: Batch instruction did not say whether a pause stops the timer. Uniformity results met specification.
records.root_cause: Ambiguous batch instruction about timer behaviour during interruptions.
records.product_impact: No impact: blend uniformity within limits.

capa.summary: Batch instruction reworded: timer restarts if blending is interrupted.

records.description: Excipient lot received with moisture above the limit on the incoming test, although the supplier certificate showed a compliant value.
records.immediate_action: Lot quarantined; supplier notified; production schedule changed.
records.investigation_summary: Supplier certificate value was from a different lot. Incoming sampling plan relied on certificate only for this material class.
records.root_cause: Incoming sampling plan accepted supplier certificates without identity of lot testing.
records.product_impact: Material rejected before use; no product made.

capa.summary: Incoming plan changed to test moisture on every lot; supplier asked to correct certificate process.

records.description: Second-person verification signature missing on a weigh sheet for the active ingredient.
records.immediate_action: Weighing re-verified against balance printout by QA.
records.investigation_summary: Sheet layout put the verification box below the page fold. Printout confirmed the correct weight.
records.root_cause: Weigh sheet layout hid the second-person verification box.
records.product_impact: No impact: weight verified from printout.

capa.summary: Weigh sheet layout revised and approved.

records.description: Differential pressure in the filling room fell below the alarm limit for 40 minutes during filling.
records.immediate_action: Filling stopped; room status assessed; product from the period segregated.
records.investigation_summary: Damper actuator was sticking and could not hold position. Maintenance records showed no preventive check of actuators.
records.root_cause: Failed damper actuator; no preventive maintenance task existed for actuators.
records.product_impact: Segregated product tested and found compliant; environmental monitoring normal.

capa.summary: Actuator replaced; preventive maintenance task added; alarm response time target defined.
capa.effectiveness_result: verified effective: no recurrence in 6 months

records.description: Assay result for a stability sample was below the lower limit.
records.immediate_action: Result held; sample and standards retained; laboratory supervisor informed.
records.investigation_summary: Phase 1 review found the analyst used the wrong dilution volume. Retest by a second analyst under the approved plan met specification.
records.root_cause: Analyst error: incorrect dilution volume; method step was not highlighted on the worksheet.
records.product_impact: No product impact after invalidation of the original result.

capa.summary: Method worksheet updated to highlight dilution step; analyst retrained.

records.description: Visible residue found in the mixer after the cleaning cycle and before the next batch.
records.immediate_action: Next batch held; mixer re-cleaned and swab tested.
records.investigation_summary: Spray ball on one arm was partially blocked by dried product.
records.root_cause: Partially blocked spray ball; no inspection step for spray balls in the cleaning checklist.
records.product_impact: Swab results after re-cleaning met limits; no product contact with residue.

capa.summary: Spray ball cleaned and inspected; inspection step added to checklist.

records.description: Cartons for one pallet were printed with an expiry date 12 months too late.
records.immediate_action: Line stopped; all pallets since last check quarantined; 100% carton inspection started.
records.investigation_summary: Label template version in the printer was not updated after the shelf-life change; no verification step compared printed text to the approved master.
records.root_cause: Printer template not updated after a shelf-life change and no independent check against the approved master.
records.product_impact: Affected cartons never left the site; all reworked or destroyed.

capa.summary: Template change tied to change control; printed text verified against master at start-up and hourly.

records.description: Operator ran the press without a completed training record for the latest procedure version.
records.immediate_action: Operator paused; training completed before continuing.
records.investigation_summary: Training matrix was not updated when the procedure revision was released.
records.root_cause: Training matrix not updated after procedure revision.
records.product_impact: No impact: operator had been trained on the previous version, differences were minor.

capa.summary: Correction only: training completed; matrix updated. No CAPA needed (isolated event).

records.description: Foreign particles found in blister foil received from a packaging supplier.
records.immediate_action: Lot quarantined; supplier notified; inspection of retained lots.
records.investigation_summary: Supplier traced the particles to a slitting blade fragment.
records.root_cause: Supplier slitting process generated blade fragments; supplier inspection did not detect them.
records.product_impact: Foil rejected; no product made with it.

capa.summary: Supplier corrective action report accepted; incoming visual check added for three lots.

records.description: Balance failed the daily verification with a 0.3 g error.
records.immediate_action: Balance tagged out; spare used.
records.investigation_summary: Balance was dirty and the leveling foot had been bumped.
records.root_cause: Leveling foot displaced during cleaning.
records.product_impact: No product weighed on the balance since the last good check.

capa.summary: Correction only: balance leveled and re-verified.

records.description: Granulator product temperature exceeded the upper process limit for 12 minutes.
records.immediate_action: Batch stopped and quarantined; temperature trend preserved.
records.investigation_summary: Temperature control loop behaved differently after a controller software update. The update had been applied without a change assessment.
records.root_cause: Controller update changed loop tuning; the update was not assessed under change control.
records.product_impact: Granule quality out of expectation; batch rejected.

capa.summary: Tuning restored and re-verified; software updates now require change control and verification.
capa.effectiveness_result: verified effective: no recurrence in 9 months

records.description: Warehouse temperature reached 25.8 C for two hours, above the 25 C limit.
records.immediate_action: Door left open on a delivery day closed; excursion logged.
records.investigation_summary: Door interlock was bypassed to speed deliveries.
records.root_cause: Delivery door left open; no alarm delay set.
records.product_impact: Existing stability data supports short excursions up to 30 C; no impact.

capa.summary: Correction only: door closed, alarm delay added.

records.description: Two pages of a batch record were missing at review.
records.immediate_action: Batch held; pages reconstructed from line printouts with QA review.
records.investigation_summary: Pages were lost when records were printed in two sets.
records.root_cause: Print process split records without a page-count control.
records.product_impact: Reconstruction approved by QA; no quality impact found.

capa.summary: Page-count line added to record cover sheet and checked at assembly.

records.description: One dissolution vessel result fell below the stage 1 limit.
records.immediate_action: Result held; apparatus inspected.
records.investigation_summary: Vessel centering was out of tolerance. Re-qualification confirmed all other vessels in tolerance.
records.root_cause: Dissolution vessel centering out of tolerance; no routine centering check.
records.product_impact: Prior results from the affected vessel reviewed; none outside limits.

capa.summary: Centering check added to monthly maintenance; vessel replaced.

records.description: Cleaning log entry was completed 14 hours after the cleaning.
records.immediate_action: Entry annotated with the actual time; supervisor reminded.
records.investigation_summary: Operator forgot to record at the end of shift.
records.root_cause: Late recording; no reminder at shift handover.
records.product_impact: No impact: cleaning verified by swab.

capa.summary: Correction only; reminder added to shift handover sheet.

records.description: Wrong label reel loaded; detected at line clearance before printing.
records.immediate_action: Reel removed; line clearance repeated.
records.investigation_summary: Similar reel numbers stored next to each other.
records.root_cause: Look-alike reels stored together.
records.product_impact: No impact: detected before use.

capa.summary: Correction only; storage locations separated.

records.description: Fill volume drifted out of range at start-up of the oral solution filler.
records.immediate_action: Filling stopped; filled bottles since the last check segregated.
records.investigation_summary: Pump seal wear caused inconsistent delivery.
records.root_cause: Pump seal wear; maintenance interval longer than the seal life.
records.product_impact: Segregated bottles reweighed; out-of-range bottles rejected.

capa.summary: Seal replacement interval shortened; start-up fill check added.

records.description: An analyst without qualification on the assay method ran a release assay.
records.immediate_action: Results held and repeated by a qualified analyst.
records.investigation_summary: Instrument access did not check training status.
records.root_cause: Access control for the instrument software was not linked to training records.
records.product_impact: Repeat testing by a qualified analyst met specification.

capa.summary: Access to the instrument software linked to current training status.

records.description: Metal detector failed the start-up challenge test with the ferrous test piece.
records.immediate_action: Line stopped; all product since the last passed challenge quarantined and re-inspected.
records.investigation_summary: Sensitivity setting was lost after a power cycle and returned to a default.
records.root_cause: Sensitivity setting not retained after power interruption; no settings check after restart.
records.product_impact: All quarantined product re-inspected; no contaminants found.

capa.summary: Settings locked and a restart checklist added requiring a challenge test.
